definition: the busy time when people travel to work
description: Inside a packed underground train, seen as a selfie. A grinning young woman in a red puffer jacket and a white beanie is squeezed against a young man in a blue coat. All around them people in winter coats stand pressed together, holding the poles and hand straps. A businessman in a suit holds his briefcase above his head to make space, and a woman holds her coffee cup high in the crowd. As the crowd pushes, the young woman's smile turns into a shocked face. Bright ceiling lights run along the carriage.

the man in the blue coat
